description: Competitor domains: the websites competing with a domain in Google organic search, each with the keywords both rank for, the average position on them, and the competitor's total ranking keywords and estimated traffic; up to 100 in one $0.048 call. Use when you need to find a site's real SEO competitors (bare domain; www. is dropped). No data returns empty results (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.048 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

limit.description: Maximum competitors to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).

target.description: Bare domain like example.com (no scheme, path or port; a leading www. is dropped).

name: competitor_domains
title: Competitor domains (up to 100)
